title: Terms Clause: The Allowance Granted After a Heavy Draw on the Coverage
content:
Where a plan of the Belrose Jewelry Protection and Care Plans drew heavily in the coverage year just ended, less than the whole of the yearly benefit allowance is granted for the year now beginning, and how much less turns on the settlements standing on the plan over its life.

Where what the plan drew in the coverage year just ended stands at or above 0.5 of the yearly benefit allowance and 2 or more settlement entries stand on the plan over its life, 75 percent of the yearly benefit allowance is granted. Where what it drew stands at or above that share of the yearly benefit allowance and fewer than 2 settlement entries stand on the plan over its life, 90 percent of the yearly benefit allowance is granted. In any other case the whole of the yearly benefit allowance is granted.

## What each case grants

| What the plan drew in the coverage year just ended | Settlement entries over the life of the plan | The share of the yearly benefit allowance granted |
|---|---|---|
| at or above 0.5 of the yearly benefit allowance | 2 or more | 75 percent |
| at or above 0.5 of the yearly benefit allowance | fewer than 2 | 90 percent |
| below 0.5 of the yearly benefit allowance | any | the whole of it |

## The yearly benefit allowance each plan sets

| Plan | Yearly benefit allowance |
|---|---|
| Manufacturer Limited Warranty | 350.00 USD |
| Belrose Care Plan 2-Year | 1200.00 USD |
| Belrose Care Plan 3-Year | 2500.00 USD |
| Belrose Care Plan 5-Year | 5000.00 USD |
| Belrose Lifetime Care Plan | 12000.00 USD |
| Belrose Heirloom Protection Plan | 40000.00 USD |

## Boundary readings

On coverage whose yearly benefit allowance is 5000.00 USD, a draw of exactly 2500.00 USD in the coverage year just ended stands at 0.5 of that allowance, so the first or second reading is taken according to the settlements standing over the life of the plan. A draw of 2499.99 USD stands below that share, so the whole of the allowance is granted whatever the settlements over the life of the plan show.
